title: Practice 3: Prepositional endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Weasels eat great numbers of rodents.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.prompt: Tom wears black-rimmed glasses.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Я был с ним на ___ (дружеский) ноге.
exercises.prompt: I was on close terms with him.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
